## TRA Timeline

#### SPAC business combination and TRA execution

- 2022-02-09: SilverBox Engaged Merger Corp I business combination with Authentic Brands LLC closes; executed Tax Receivable Agreement dated February 9, 2022 between BRC Inc., Authentic Brands LLC, and Sterling New Investment Holdings LLC (Agent).
- 2022-02-10: 8-K reports closing and files the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.2.

## Explanation

The TRA originates from BRC Inc.'s February 9, 2022 Up-C SPAC business combination, with Sterling New Investment Holdings LLC acting as Agent for the Continuing Unitholders of Authentic Brands LLC. BRC pays 85% of the Cumulative Net Realized Tax Benefit on basis step-ups from the redemption of preferred and Common Units at the Business Combination, future exchanges of Common Units for Class A stock, Blocker Corp pre-existing tax attributes, and imputed-interest deductions on TRA payments. No amendments, restatements, or terminations have been filed. BRC has not recorded a liability under the TRA because a full valuation allowance has been maintained against the underlying deferred tax assets through every annual report since execution; the contract remains in force and the initial Q1 2022 cancel signal was a valuation-allowance false positive. See `contract_log.md` for the same-contract analysis.
